acceptance_predicates.description: The command supports selected/all agents and workloads with typed validation.
Live responses are stored through the runtime-owned capture boundary with redaction and provenance.
A subsequent run can select the cassette and is network-denied with digest-bound replay.

definition_of_done: ASB and TUI command/transport tests cover record and replay.
Independent review and hosted checks pass.

inputs.description: Typed agent/workload selection and the runtime capture request.

outputs.description: Redacted, sealed cassette and digest-bound offline replay result.

gates.description: Selection, redaction, sealing, replay provenance, and network-denial checks pass.
